text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Liamine Zeroual adresses African Youth Movement's congress in Algiers.
- Algeria Islamist Hamas's hardline wing attacks the "soft" policy followed by its leader Mahfoud Nahanah.
- Opposition parties await Zeroual's final words over reforms plan ahead of the national conference.
- The government adopts measures to curb tax evasion.
